review_text: I recently visited this Starbucks branch with some friends and we had a great time. We only ordered drinks, but just like the other branches, the quality was consistent and delicious. The atmosphere of the place was nice and relaxing, making it a good spot to catch up and spend time together. Overall, it was an enjoyable visit and another reminder of why Starbucks remains one of my go-to coffee places. A solid 4 out of 5 stars.

The barista bulled the kitchen rag after wipeing the tables right over my coffe while preparing it dripping. I had to buy throw it and buy another coffee. This store should really oversee their hygiene routines. It’s the first Starbucks where I have ever experienced this and I usually visit Starbucks on a daily basis since years back.

I purchased their Cafe Latte and it was good. It wasn't a strong coffee and suits my liking. The area where I was seated was kinda hot. I wish their AC would reach all parts of the cafe. Their staff are nice, especially the girl at the cashier. It was pretty crowded when I got there but the outside seats are available. The banana bread was okay, too. It wasn't that sweet, though. Sadly, the charging slots are not everywhere and I think there wasn't an internet connection available, too. Overall, it's a 3/5 for me.

Starbucks Abreeza has recently undergone a transformation, and the results are nothing short of impressive. The newly renovated store exudes a modern and spacious ambiance, elevating the overall coffee-drinking experience. The open layout contributes to a more comfortable and inviting atmosphere, providing ample room for patrons to enjoy their beverages and work in a relaxed setting. In addition to the physical transformation, the staff's friendliness remains a standout feature. The welcoming demeanor of the team, combined with the fresh and spacious interior, creates an even more enjoyable environment for customers. The freelancer-friendly policy is enhanced by the revamped space, offering freelancers not only a welcoming atmosphere but also a well-designed and accommodating setting to focus on their work. The thoughtfulness in catering to the needs of remote workers is evident in both the physical layout and the friendly attitude of the staff. The commitment to cleanliness extends to the renovated space, with the bathroom maintaining its pristine condition. This attention to detail reflects Starbucks Abreeza's dedication to providing a hygienic and comfortable environment for all visitors. With a diverse menu of delicious foods and signature coffees, Starbucks Abreeza continues to impress both with its offerings and its newly enhanced surroundings. The recent renovation solidifies Starbucks Abreeza as not just a coffee shop but a destination where friendly service, a conducive work environment, and a fresh, modern aesthetic come together for an exceptional experience.

My daughter's birthday last March 10, we went to Starbucks Abreeza Mall to claim her yearly free birthday cake slice of her choice. The barista seemed unaware of this and she required us to show a lot of proof like government ID, Starbucks downloaded app on my daughter's phone,etc. Then she consulted her manager about it. We waited for almost 30 minutes only to be told that we are required to make a purchase a week before the claiming of the free birthday cake slice. This is our very bad experience in a Starbucks branch in claiming the free cake. We do this every year in any Starbucks branch but this Starbucks in Abreeza Mall was the only one that we were not able to claim the complimentary birthday cake slice! So frustrating! If I was not in a hurry, I would've talked with the manager (who wouldn't come out of his/her office, by the way) and would tell her that ALL Starbucks branches give complimentary birthday cake slices to their Starbucks card holders on the day of their birthday. I plan to escalate my complaint to the Starbucks Philippines office.

It's not the place you would go for decent coffee, but what they make here is well below the low benchmark of the US chain. All of their cold drinks are mostly ice water, hot drinks are scalding hot even if you requested warm, and you won't find any nitro cold brew, except in Makati (every other franchise just has revolting watered down cold brew). No wifi provided, though the mall wifi is sometimes usable. No toilet, unlike at other Davao Starbucks. Tables are cleared only on request, or the mess just sits there for hours, despite having 7-8 staff, always the same experience on numerous visits. Sadly Abreeza has very few coffee options, CBTL is so much better but usually crowded.
